coder_notes: Season 24 of Something Was Wrong (troubled teen industry). All 14 chunk files were read in full in consecutive line ranges; notes with verbatim quotes are in notes.md. Episodes 5 and 9 are expert interviews and episode 25 is a team update (its case update concerns Season 18), so they add no person records. The final file is a 'WCN Presents' episode (John Callas) filed in this season folder; it was coded. Coding conventions: (1) In most stories the abusing institution is the program itself. A program's own staff/therapist is recorded as a contact only when the person (or family) raised the harm with them; the program's knowledge of its own abuse is not by itself treated as the harm 'reaching' an institution. (2) harmed_by_institution_ever is set true only where an institution responded to a disclosure or report by punishing, blaming, counter-accusing or exposing the person (e.g., punished SOS letters, consequences for 'lying', counter-accusation of hacking), not merely because the program was abusive. (3) Where harm ended because parents removed the child, the child aged out, or ran away, outcome is not_protected even if later civil awards or closures occurred. (4) Intro-episode historical/news cases (episode 1, episode 4 intro, Turning Winds and Island View intros) were coded as persons where the show tells harm plus an institutional aftermath; others went to others_mentioned. (5) Perpetrator and family names were removed or avoided in quotes; '[perpetrator]' marks a removed name. Program/institution names are given as the show names them. Uncertain items: whether the police came in Molly's home incident; whether Hyde School knew of Dylan's assault; exact years for Dylan's and Haley's placements; Kalin's 2017 death is not attributed by the show to the program. Max is referred to as both 'she' and 'they' in the transcript. Shannon (a parent) is coded as a person harmed by coercive financial pressure from the program's seminars; she also describes taking part in pressuring other parents. No unassigned episode was opened.
